name: Sample Size
description: Calculate the required sample size for variance and mean tests
whenToUse: When you need to know how many observations a test requires: computes the required sample size for variance tests (chi-square, F) and mean tests (one- and two-sample t) from the effect to detect, the significance level and the target power.
resultSummary: With n = {n}, a power of {power}% is achieved at α = {alpha}.
nOverflow: The required sample size reaches or exceeds 5,000 — the effect is very difficult to detect with these parameters.
